📊 *weekly triage digest* — 2026-09-09 → 2026-09-16

*Volume:* 0 alerts triaged · 0 posted · 0 suppressed to digest
⚠ Not a quiet week — a coverage gap. The host was suspended (Windows Modern Standby) from 2026-09-03T06:41:53Z to 2026-09-16T19:19:44Z (~13.5 days, confirmed via Kernel-Power / Power-Troubleshooter event log), which swallowed this entire digest window plus the tail of the prior one. No poll-cycles, no heartbeats, no commits, and no `docs/actionable/` or `docs/messages/` entries exist for 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-15 — the routine did not run and find nothing, it did not run at all.

*Top recurrences this week:* none fired — nothing ran to observe them.

*New this week:* none — no KB entry has `first_seen` inside the window.

*Aging:* carried forward unchanged from the 2026-08-31 digest (all KB state is frozen at last_seen ≤ 2026-09-02T20:04Z). 6 entries remain ≥30d since `fix_status` last changed — oldest: `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`, still `investigating` at ~115d / 280 occurrences (was ~99d at the last digest, now three consecutive digests with no status movement).

*Concentration:* n/a — zero occurrences recorded this week.

*Suppression:* n/a — zero alerts triaged, nothing to suppress.

One thing worth doing next week: this is the 3rd occurrence of this failure mode (5.6d on 2026-08-26, 8d on 2026-07-23, now 13.5d) and each has been longer than the last — worth hardening the scheduled task against sleep (wake timer / "prevent sleep" power policy) rather than re-diagnosing it again next time.
